title_en: Retired Microscope & Scanner Back to Shine
title_zh: 退役显微镜与扫描仪再发光
description_en: Retired microscopes and slide scanners, re-homed with labs and schools that need them: what X-WOW did from 2018, why to ship the optics and not the stand, a self-serve noticeboard opening soon, and five organisations doing this today.
description_zh: 让退役的显微镜和切片扫描仪去到需要它们的实验室和学校：X-WOW 从 2018 年起做过什么、为什么只寄光学件不寄镜架、即将开放的自助留言板，以及今天在做这件事的五家机构。
